startIn.provenance: MEASURED FROM CAD (33950 Robot.step): the 22.0 in box with the flower bar out. The team says the bar is STOWED at the start (Oct 27), making the robot its 17.4 in frame (9.6 in ahead of the drive centre, 7.8 in behind); Zenith has one centre of rotation (-3.2 in, set for the 22 in box), so a 17.4 in start box would be placed 2.3 in off the wall. The 22 in box puts the back on the wall exactly as the stowed robot does.

expandedIn.provenance: MEASURED FROM CAD (33950 Robot.step, Onshape export Oct 27): flower bar out: 22.0 x 17.84 in

centreOfRotationIn.provenance: MEASURED FROM CAD (33950 Robot.step, Onshape export Oct 27): the drive centre (midway between the four wheels) sits 3.2 in behind the middle of the 22 in box, because the flower bar sticks out at the front

heightIn.provenance: MEASURED FROM CAD (33950 Robot.step, Onshape export Oct 27): top of the nectar shooter motor, 14.93 in above the floor

maxForwardVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER (SET FROM SIM): matches pedro/Constants and the SimLoop drive model, not the real robot; measure with Pedro's Foresight Tuner

maxStrafeVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER (SET FROM SIM): matches pedro/Constants and the SimLoop drive model, not the real robot; measure with Pedro's Foresight Tuner

forwardDecelInPerS2.provenance: PLACEHOLDER (SET FROM SIM): matches pedro/Constants and the SimLoop drive model, not the real robot; measure with Pedro's Foresight Tuner

strafeDecelInPerS2.provenance: PLACEHOLDER (SET FROM SIM): matches pedro/Constants and the SimLoop drive model, not the real robot; measure with Pedro's Foresight Tuner

maxAngularVelRadPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: same as AimController.MAX_TURN_RATE_RAD_PER_S; measure by spinning at full yaw

defaultPathSpeedFraction.provenance: SET BY HAND: 80 percent of full speed on every path unless a step says otherwise (BioHorsZenithRobot.DEFAULT_SPEED_FRACTION)

mouths.provenance: MEASURED FROM CAD (33950 Robot.step, Onshape export Oct 27): the flower mech's opening: between the frame front (9.6 in ahead of the drive centre) and the flower bar tip (14.2 in), 13.2 in between its side plates; pollen rolls up the floor-level intake ramp to the two roller stages

capacity.provenance: SET BY HAND: confirmed by Sushil (Oct 27): the robot holds 4 pollen; also BIOBUZZ G407

settleS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: time to settle before launching

commands.name: intakeOn
commands.summary: Runs the intake inward and keeps it running.

commands.name: spinUp
commands.summary: Brings the pollen shooter up to speed; ends once it is at speed (or after 2 s).

commands.name: score
commands.summary: Launches count pollen into the alliance's up hive cell: spins the pollen shooter up if needed, opens the pollen gate and feeds with the intake, then closes the gate. The robot must stand still while it runs.

commands.name: flowerBarDown
commands.summary: Puts the flower bar down (out and low) to collect from a flower. The robot is at its longest.

commands.name: flowerBarStow
commands.summary: Folds the flower bar up. The robot is at its shortest.

conditions.name: holdingPiece
conditions.summary: At least one pollen is aboard. ESTIMATE: the robot has no pollen sensor yet (PollenEstimate).

conditions.name: hopperFull
conditions.summary: The robot holds 4 pollen, the most it may. ESTIMATE from intake run time (PollenEstimate).

conditions.name: hopperEmpty
conditions.summary: The robot holds no pollen. ESTIMATE (PollenEstimate).
